C-STABILIZE-DIRTY-RELOAD.Name: Preserve unsaved documents during external reload
C-STABILIZE-DIRTY-RELOAD.Summary: External add/change events must never silently replace unsaved local content, including when liveReload defaults on or a read-only/watch flag is present. Reuse the existing per-tab conflict notification and explicit reload choice.
C-STABILIZE-DIRTY-RELOAD.ApprovalBasis: The owner approved the stabilization recovery on 2026-11-09, explicitly requested final implementation through clean green main, and delegated recommended implementation decisions. The bounded recovery decision is to repair the confirmed dirty-buffer overwrite independently of future agent visibility and journal features.

Goals.Goal: Protect direct-data and delayed disk reloads; re-check tab ownership, generation and local state across asynchronous work.
Keep automatic reload of clean tabs under existing liveReload, autoSave, preview and watch eligibility; preserve cursor, snapshots and same-content skipping.
Only the existing explicit conflict reload choice may discard the local content it confirms; subsequent edits require a fresh choice.

Constraints.Constraint: No backend, preference default, dependency, release identity or live-app changes; no commits or push in this task.
Dirty preview, locked and watch tabs receive the same protection as editable tabs; clean read-only/watch behavior remains supported.
One bounded root-cause regression cycle and affected checks replace a new repeated whole-context review loop under the approved recovery stop rule.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-032 live-reload implemented by M-011 editor store; focused existing tests and V-M-032.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Agent annotations, journal/merge engine, checkbox propagation and test-profile isolation.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Regressions fail on the unmodified implementation and pass after the repair for direct and disk dirty events and local edits during delayed work.
Clean reload, explicit conflict choices, snapshots, hash-skip, generation ordering and tab lifetime checks pass.
